methodology.youtubeEmerging: Current lead indicator: recent public review/build activity and recent-view footprint. Old lifetime views cannot create an emerging signal.
methodology.youtubeEvergreen: Historical awareness footprint kept separately. It can describe durable recognition but cannot strengthen a current buying recommendation by itself.
methodology.manufacturer: Official maker pages monitored for newly observed RTA/mod/board/product headings. New page text is a launch radar, not proof of Romanian demand.
methodology.truthRule: External signals can only corroborate a Romanian market signal; they cannot replace verified Romanian sales/bestseller evidence and are never labelled Romania sales.
